error3390.officialHtmlText: 3390 Проверка статуса буфера Буфер не активный. Текущий статус буфера: <значение_0>. OrderId: <значение_1>. Gtin: <значение_2>. OmsId: <значение_3> Возвращается в случае, если значение параметра «bufferStatus» (Статус буфера) отличен от «ACTIVE» (Буфер создан)
error3390.meaning: The buffer status is other than ACTIVE;3390 alone is not a transient-PENDING classification.

bufferStates.EXHAUSTED: Буфер и пулы РЭ не содержат больше кодов
bufferStates.scope: Buffer state is separate from order status, usage and circulation.

blockList.meaning: Lists identifiers of code packages already issued from this order and GTIN.
restrictions: Marking-code suborder has not been closed.
First print request was performed through API.

blockRetry.meaning: Re-obtains already emitted codes after communication failure; does not create an order.
restrictions: Codes were previously requested through API.
Marking-code order has not been closed.
Release method or FEACN/TN VED group has not been closed or blocked.

normalCodes.meaning: Obtain marking codes from an order; existing application correctly treats this GET as a consuming issuance operation and disables automatic replay.

reviewConclusions: Recognize only exact3390+EXHAUSTED as recovery progress, not all3390errors.
Reconcile both directstatusEXHAUSTED and HTTPerrorEXHAUSTED and persistedactiveerror afterrestart.
Replay previously issued packages while localorderreceipt is incomplete; any existingcode in a block is not proof the wholeblock was stored.
Preserve originalorder,requestkey,settings,shop/OMS/GTIN and inventory/legalstatus; never create a replacement paidorder.
Validate response identity before fetching/inserting codes; official current responsefields and legacy omissions must be distinguished.
Closed/UI-first/blocked orders may not permit retry; do not promise guaranteed recovery or mark missingcodes ascomplete.
